name: Crunchy Fruit & Nut Muesli
ingredients_raw: Rolled Oats (34.2%), Nuts & Raisins 22.9% (Raisins, Dates, Almonds), Whole Wheat Flakes 15.2% (Wheat, Sugar, lodised Salt, Cereal Extract and Antioxidants-INS 322& INS 307b), Invert Syrup, Dehydrated Fruits 6.6% (Mango Powder, Banana, Cranberry (1%), Papaya, Strawberry Powder & Lemon Juice Powder), Broken Rolled Wheat, Wheat Bran, Apple Juice Concentrate (2%), Oat Bran Honey, Beetroot Powder and Antioxidant (INS 307b).
